notes.title: What's new in BATTLESTEAM 0.3.6.0?

tags.bug: 1. Switching localization now works correctly in the menu and switches the language;

tags.feature: 2. English voice acting for characters to select English voice acting for characters, select English from the menu;
3. Attached voice acting for the arms dealer at the location of the "Wild West";
4. Attached voice acting for the doctor at the location of the "Wild West";
5. Attached voice acting for the doctor and the merchant at the location with the ships;
6. Sound design for characters is now used from the settings;
7. 2-new skins for "sawn-off" weapon;
8. Purchase of new skins in the store and selection in the inventory;

tags.bug: 9. Fixed a bug with returning to the gameplay from the menu;
10. The choice of skin for weapons now works out stably;

tags.feature: 11. The ability to minimize the matchmaking window and move through the main menu at this moment;
12. Displaying in the menu in a minimized form of matchmaking results;
13. At the start of the application, the music settings are now taken from the general ones;
14. Displaying the main characteristics of allies;

notes.title: What's new in version 0_0_3_5 of BATTLESTEAM?

tags.feature: 4. UI when we want to exit the game when pressing ESC during the game;
5. Localization of the main items in the menu;
6. Daily task icons on the tiles;
7. New professional voice acting of a “dwarf-pirate” seller at a location with ships;
9. New professional voice acting for a physician at a location with ships;
10. A lighthouse for entourage in a location with ships;
11. Localization in Russian and English in daily tasks;

12. The statuses of daily tasks are now displayed as unfulfilled, completed, which will allow you to pick up a reward, and are blocked until the next daily reset, resetting daily tasks will take place at 23.59: 59;
13. Available quest and charging coins for daily entry into the game;
14. Improvements on the server side in terms of optimization and logs;
15. The quest "Conqueror" is available to break 30 blocks;
16. Available quest “Slaughter” to play 10 games;
17. Available quest “Came, saw, won” - win one game;
18. The quest “Victory Series” is available - win 3 games during the day;
20. The quest “Art of battle" is available - to kill 25 players;
21. The main screen now displays the number of tasks the completed counter and the total;

tags.bug: 22. Fixed a bug when the menu does not show who is waiting for the game on the list;

tags.feature: 23. Statistics are now available to all users, but have been reset;

tags.bug: 24. At the location with the ships, a bug with respawn of chests at the base was fixed;
25. At a location with trains, fixed a bug with respawn of chests at the base;

tags.balance_change: 26. Chests on the game platform are now cut within the platform - train location;

tags.bug: 27. Fixed bug with “respawn” of chests on ships;
28. Fixed bug with “respawn” of chests on airships;

tags.feature: 29. Added “experimental” shooting mode;

notes.title: Training mode update
notes.content: In the near future, players will receive an update in which the fully redesigned training mode will be available, characters in the training will receive additional animation. In training mode, the construction and holding of the attacking waves will be available. You need to build a defense to contain the attacking forces of the enemy. The animation process can be viewed on our youtube channel.

tags.feature: In the near future, players will receive an update in which the fully redesigned training mode will be available, characters in the training will receive additional animation.
In training mode, the construction and holding of the attacking waves will be available.

notes.title: What's new 0.2.0.0?

tags.feature: - New characters, all old characters have been redesigned;
- Completely redesigned menu;
- Display in the menu of users who are currently looking for a game;
- Now available for macOS users;
- Traps: a new look and shape;
- Sniper mode for 1 rifle;
- A few new blocks that will help to better hold the defense;
- Better integration with Steam;
- Changed character icons in the menu and gameplay;

tags.balance_change: - Changed prices for characters in the store;

tags.feature: - All the icons in the store on the platform are changed, weapons and blocks are divided by color elements for quick access;

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug with scaling at some resolutions, elements, in general, have become more compact;

tags.feature: - Changed all the buildings on the platform at the level of the wild west;
- A link to the discord has been added to the menu to make it more convenient to communicate;
- Slightly improved location with loading the game;

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug with the UI when no weapon is selected;

tags.feature: - Button to exit the game;
- A new effect when you step on a trap;
- A sign near the doctor;
- Visual improvements to the location of the wild west;

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug at the level with airships (falling through the platform);

tags.feature: - New respawn points for chests in locations with airships;
